context: The transitions are defined as follows: (s1 , 0) transitions to s2,0 , and (s1 , 1) transition to s2,1 . All rewards are 0. By defining T1 w := H · |w|, it is readily seen that M is linear Bellman complete with respect to the above feature mappings. Let us choose w? = 1. Then Bellman-linearity of V2 (x) would require that there is some w̄ ∈ R so that φ1 (s1 , 0) · w̄ = H, φ1 (s1 , 1) · w̄ = H. But since φ1 (s1 , 1) = 2 and φ1 (s1 , 0) = 1, there is no such w̄.
